label: Organizations headquartered in Fremont listed on Crunchbase
source: Crunchbase, hub 'Fremont Companies'
note: Crunchbase counts any organization (for-profit, non-profit, any age) whose HQ is Fremont, California. Not a startup-only count.

label: All-time funding raised by Fremont-headquartered organizations tracked by Crunchbase
source: Crunchbase, hub 'Fremont Companies'
note: Across 720 funding rounds; includes public companies' post-IPO rounds. Not a per-year figure.

label: Early-stage startups headquartered in Fremont on Crunchbase's 'Fremont Startups' hub
source: Crunchbase, hub 'Fremont Startups'
note: Crunchbase's startup hub; average founding date Nov 2015, mostly Pre-Seed to Series C. These 154 raised $4.3B across 326 rounds. Crunchbase does not publish its exact 'startup' filter.

label: Venture-backed startups in Fremont listed by VCBacked.co
source: VCBacked.co, 'VC-Backed Startups in Fremont, California (2026)'
note: Directory of companies with a recorded funding round; page's $744.1M total only sums the 25 companies visible on page 1. Site includes some grant and post-IPO debt rounds.

label: Valuation of Weee!, Fremont-headquartered online grocer, at its Series E
source: Built In SF, 'These 5 Bay Area Tech Companies Raised $3.1B+ Total in February'
note: $425M Series E led by SoftBank Vision Fund 2. StartupBlink lists Weee! as Fremont's only unicorn. Valuation has not been publicly re-marked since.

label: Raised by Fremont-based Alamar Biosciences in its April 2026 Nasdaq IPO (ALMR)
source: Renaissance Capital, 'Alamar Biosciences prices upsized IPO'
note: 11.3M shares at $17, top of range. Company campus at 47071 Bayside Parkway, Fremont.

label: Gross proceeds of Fremont-based Cytek Biosciences' July 2021 Nasdaq IPO (CTKB)
source: Cytek Biosciences, IPO pricing press release
note: Approximately $200M expected gross proceeds at $17/share; HQ 47215 Lakeview Blvd, Fremont per 10-K.

label: Raised by Pony.ai (dual HQ Fremont and Guangzhou) in its Nov 2024 Nasdaq IPO (PONY)
source: S&P Global AutoTechInsight, 'Pony.ai debuts on Nasdaq'
note: 20M ADS at $13. Wikipedia lists HQ as Guangzhou, China and Fremont, California; primarily a Chinese company with US base in Fremont.

label: High-tech, life science and clean technology firms in Fremont (City of Fremont)
source: City of Fremont Economic Development, City Profile
note: Exact wording: 'over 1,200 high tech, life science, and clean technology firms'. The city does not publish separate cleantech/biotech/med-device counts.

label: Advanced manufacturing companies in Fremont (City of Fremont)
source: City of Fremont Economic Development, City Profile
note: Exact wording: 'over 900 advanced manufacturing companies in Fremont'.

label: Manufacturing jobs in Fremont (City economic development site)
source: Think Silicon Valley (City of Fremont economic development site), Advanced Manufacturing
note: Exact wording: 'nearly 45,000 manufacturing jobs, with one in three Fremont jobs in the sector' and 'nearly all of its 900 manufacturers are engaged in technology'. Undated; Propmodo (Aug 2025) cites 65,000 manufacturing jobs, so figures differ by source.

label: Small businesses in Fremont (City of Fremont)
source: City of Fremont Economic Development, City Profile
note: Exact wording: 'over 3,600 small businesses'.

label: Fremont residents who hold a patent, per 100 residents (City of Fremont)
source: City of Fremont Economic Development, City Profile
note: Exact wording: '1.4 in every 100 Fremont residents holds a patent'. Methodology and date not given by the city.

label: Industrial space in Fremont (City of Fremont)
source: City of Fremont Economic Development, Employment Hubs
note: Square feet. Exact wording: 'Fremont's 50 million square feet of industrial space', over two-thirds of it in the Bayside Industrial Zone.

label: Size of the Warm Springs Innovation District (City of Fremont)
source: Think Silicon Valley (City of Fremont economic development site), Innovation
note: Acres. Plan calls for 'more than 20,000 new jobs' and '4,000 new housing units'. Planning targets, not current counts.

label: New jobs planned for the Warm Springs Innovation District (City of Fremont)
source: Think Silicon Valley (City of Fremont economic development site), Innovation
note: Planning target ('more than 20,000 new jobs'), not jobs already created.

label: Research and development space at Ardenwood Technology Park (life sciences cluster)
source: City of Fremont Economic Development, Employment Hubs
note: Square feet.

label: Launch date of Innovate Bay, San Francisco Bay University's startup incubator in Fremont
source: San Francisco Bay University press release (Business Wire)
note: Located at SFBU campus, 161 Mission Falls Lane, Fremont. Cohort size and funding not disclosed.

label: Fremont's rank among 100 large U.S. cities in WalletHub's Best Large Cities to Start a Business
source: WalletHub, 'Best Large Cities to Start a Business (2026)'
note: Total score 43.34. Sub-ranks: Business Environment 35th, Access to Resources 47th, Business Costs 95th. In the 2025 edition Fremont was singled out as the city with the highest labor costs.

label: Fremont's rank as a place to start a business in Northern California (NerdWallet, cited by City)
source: City of Fremont, Awards page (citing NerdWallet)
note: Undated on the city page; the original NerdWallet study was not located.

label: Annual nameplate capacity of Tandem PV's perovskite-silicon solar module factory in Fremont
source: pv magazine USA, 'Tandem PV launches commercial perovskite-silicon manufacturing in California'
note: Megawatts; ~65,000 sq ft facility. Company's press-release dateline is San Jose, so Fremont is a major site rather than confirmed HQ.

label: Funding Ultima Genomics said it had secured when it came out of stealth
source: General Atlantic press release, "Ultima Genomics Seeks to Deliver the $100 Genome" (Jun 2, 2022)
note: The release says "approximately $600 million" from General Atlantic, Andreessen Horowitz, D1 Capital, Khosla Ventures, Lightspeed, Marius Nacht, aMoon, Playground Global and Founders Fund. Ultima's About page now says it has raised over $700 million (undated). The release does not give a headquarters city; Wikipedia lists Fremont and GenomeWeb described the company as Newark-based, so Fremont is not confirmed by a primary source. Re-checked Oct 26, 2026.
